summary: Opus Genetics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose positive clinical data from Cohort 1 of its Phase 1/2 BIRD-1 trial of OPGx-BEST1 in BEST1-related retinal diseases. The low-dose cohort enrolled five participants dosed at 1.5 x 10 vg/eye; BCVA improved in 3/5 (60%), LLVA and contrast sensitivity each in 2/5 (40%), and 75% (3/4) of evaluable participants improved on microperimetry, with no serious adverse events or dose-limiting toxicities. No deal, board recommendation, or transaction terms are stated; this is a routine clinical-data current report, not a special situation.
